comment: Basic training. Teaches the rules that differ from a normal arcade shooter: no crosshair, tap R to reload, hold R to inspect a magazine, magazine colours, sprint cost, leaning, grenade cooking and smoke, spawn protection and the 50 elimination objective.
name: Basic Training

steps.title: KORDON - basic training
steps.body: This is a slow, loud, deliberate shooter. You will learn how it wants to be played in about three minutes. Press the interact key to continue.

steps.title: There is no crosshair
steps.body: Nothing is drawn in the middle of your screen. You aim down the front sight of the weapon or through an optic. Move the mouse to look around, then continue.

steps.title: Move to the marker
steps.body: W A S D walks. Movement is heavy and has inertia: you will not stop on the spot.

steps.title: Sprint is short and expensive
steps.body: Hold Left Shift to sprint. It drains stamina, and low stamina makes you breathe hard, which makes the weapon drift. Sprint to the second marker.

steps.title: Crouch and go prone
steps.body: Left Ctrl crouches, C toggles it, Z goes prone. Lower stances are quieter, steadier and harder to hit.

steps.title: Lean around cover
steps.body: Q leans left, E leans right. Leaning keeps most of your body behind cover but your weapon is less steady while you do it.

steps.title: Shoot the target board
steps.body: Left mouse fires, right mouse aims. Recoil climbs with every shot and recovers when you stop. Hit the board three times.

steps.title: Tap R to reload
steps.body: A short press of R reloads. If your magazine still had rounds it goes back into your pouch as a yellow magazine - the rounds are never lost.

steps.title: Hold R to inspect the magazine
steps.body: Holding R pulls the magazine out and lets you count it. Only then do you see an exact number, and while you are looking you cannot fire.

steps.title: The magazine strip
steps.body: Along the bottom of the screen you always see your magazines: white is full, yellow is partly spent, red is empty. There is no round counter anywhere else. Continue when you have read the strip.

steps.title: You are never silent
steps.body: Footsteps carry further on metal grating and gravel, when you sprint, and when you are wearing heavy plates. Reloads and handling are audible too. Plan your route around it.

steps.title: Grenades: cook, throw, respect the fuze
steps.body: Press 3 to take a grenade. Hold the fire button to cook a frag - the fuze burns down and stops at the grenade's own safe minimum - then release to throw. Smoke is a real occlusion volume: militia cannot see through it either. A flashbang blinds only what it can see, and the effect shrinks with distance. You carry two grenades and respawning reissues exactly those two.

steps.title: The objective
steps.body: Free-for-all: 20 operators, no teams, no allies. The first one to personally reach 50 eliminations wins the match. You respawn five seconds after you are eliminated, briefly protected until you fire.

steps.title: Training complete
steps.body: You know the rules. Choose your magazines carefully before the round starts - the kit is locked the moment the match goes live.
